title: Resorts World Genting was pleased to host 180 delegates for the 14th MM2H National Workshop on 25 September 2026 at Resorts World Awana.
author: Resorts World Genting
body:
Resorts World Genting was pleased to host 180 delegates for the 14th MM2H National Workshop on 25 September 2026 at Resorts World Awana.

The workshop brought together licensed Malaysia My Second Home (MM2H) agents, industry stakeholders and key representatives, with Deputy Minister of Tourism, Arts and Culture, YB Tuan Chiew Choon Man, also in attendance.

The session provided a valuable platform to connect with the MM2H community, exchange perspectives and showcase the diverse experiences Resorts World Genting has to offer, spanning accommodation, attractions, dining, entertainment and hospitality.

As part of their visit, delegates were also invited to experience Eufloria Gardens & Sculpture Park, Malaysia’s largest floral glasshouse, offering a first-hand look at one of the resort’s latest attractions.

"Initiatives such as MM2H play an important role in strengthening Malaysia’s appeal to international audiences and encouraging longer-term connections with the country. Resorts World Genting is proud to support Tourism Malaysia’s efforts to promote Malaysia as a compelling destination and contribute to the continued growth of the nation’s tourism landscape." — Spencer Lee, Executive Vice President of Sales, Marketing and Public Relations, Resorts World Genting.

We look forward to continuing our collaboration with industry partners and welcoming more visitors and long-term residents to discover the many experiences Malaysia and Resorts World Genting have to offer.

#ResortsWorldGenting #MM2H

title: 24 creators. 5 countries. 3 days. 1 passport. 🛂
author: Resorts World Genting
body:
24 creators. 5 countries. 3 days. 1 passport. 🛂
MY Escape 2026, a Tourism Malaysia  x Astro Gempak influencer explorace, runs from 20 to 22 October, taking teams of 3 across Genting Highlands, Bentong, Kuala Gandah, Kuantan and Cherating.

Expect elephant-feeding at Kuala Gandah, a Sky Walk in Kuantan, tie-dye and upcycling in Cherating, and hidden tasks at every checkpoint, where it's a green stamp to move on and a red stamp to try again. 🐘

Creators from Malaysia, China, Laos, the Philippines, Vietnam and Indonesia will be showing Pahang through fresh eyes, all in conjunction with Visit Malaysia 2026–2027.

And it all kicks off here. 🏔️
Resorts World Awana is the venue where 24 creators gather before hitting the road. Cool highland air, misty mountain views and the buzz of Genting Highlands make it the perfect starting line for a 3-day adventure. Game on. 🔥

Wishing all participants the best of luck, and congratulations to Tourism Malaysia and Astro Gempak on bringing Pahang's story to a wider audience.

#MYEscape2026 #VisitMalaysia2026 #Pahang #GentingHighlands #ResortsWorldAwana #TourismMalaysia #AstroGempak Spencer Lee

title: 3 awards. 1 proud moment for Resorts World Genting. 🐉
author: Resorts World Genting
body:
3 awards. 1 proud moment for Resorts World Genting. 🐉
Big news from the highlands! Resorts World Genting has won Gold and Silver at Dragons of Malaysia 2026, and Gold at Dragons of Asia 2026 by Marketing Magazine Asia

🏆 Dragons of Asia 2026: Gold, Public Relations
 CNY in the Sky 2026: 50,000 new members, RM3.2M PR value within 3 months

🏆 Dragons of Malaysia 2026: Gold, Content Creation
 JUARA Genting: our first-ever creator-led reality series on TikTok, set in Genting SkyWorlds

🏆 Dragons of Malaysia 2026: Silver, Public Relations
 CNY in the Sky 2026: 50,000 new members, RM3.2M PR value within 3 months

"Recognition like this is always special, but what matters most is seeing our ideas connect with people," said Spencer Lee, Executive Vice President of Sales, Marketing & Public Relations, Resorts World Genting. "CNY in the Sky and JUARA Genting were very different campaigns, but both started with the same goal: creating experiences and stories that audiences would genuinely enjoy and remember. This achievement inspires us to keep pushing boundaries and finding new ways to engage our guests."

These wins belong to everyone behind the work. Thank you to our Marketing and Social Media team for the creativity and commitment, and to our business units for the support and partnership that helped bring these campaigns to life.

And to everyone who watched, shared and showed up for the stories, thank you. You made them worth telling.

▶️ Watch CNY in the Sky 2026 on YouTube: https://loom.ly/QR7-Pak
▶️ Read more on JUARA Genting: https://loom.ly/K6h6KiY

title: The Haunted Highlands 2026 is now live at Resorts World Genting, running until 20 November 2026 with a month of immersive entertainment across the resort.
author: Resorts World Genting
body:
The Haunted Highlands 2026 is now live at Resorts World Genting, running until 20 November 2026 with a month of immersive entertainment across the resort.

One of its highlights, Spookadilly x Kisah Bawah Tanah, was officially launched on 20 October 2026 at a press conference attended by Nie Ching Teo , Deputy Minister of Communications, alongside representatives from Resorts World Genting and Kisah Bawah Tanah. The experience brings a homegrown Malaysian animated world out of the screens and into Genting Highlands.

Spencer Lee, Executive Vice President of Sales, Marketing and Public Relations, Resorts World Genting, said the collaboration is another step in developing Spookadilly as a homegrown entertainment IP, combining local storytelling with immersive entertainment that families can enjoy together.

Hendra Wardi, Co-creator of Kisah Bawah Tanah, described partnering with Resorts World Genting just six months into the series' journey as an incredible milestone.

#HauntedHighlands2026 #ResortsWorldGenting #Spookadilly #KisahBawahTanah #MalaysianIP

title: We are proud to share that Resorts World Kijal, part of Genting Malaysia and the wider Genting Group, has been recognised by the Ministry of Tourism, Arts & Culture Malaysia (MOTAC) with the ASEAN...
author: Resorts World Genting
body:
We are proud to share that Resorts World Kijal, part of Genting Malaysia and the wider Genting Group, has been recognised by the Ministry of Tourism, Arts & Culture Malaysia (MOTAC) with the ASEAN Sustainable Tourism Standard 2026–2028.

This recognition reflects our commitment to responsible tourism, environmental conservation, community engagement and sustainable hospitality.

Over the years, Resorts World Kijal has implemented a range of initiatives that support marine conservation and environmental awareness, including:

🐢 Turtle Conservation Programme in collaboration with the Terengganu Fisheries Department since 2017
🥚 Establishment of our on-site Turtle Hatchery in 2023 to support turtle conservation efforts
🌊 Turtle Release Programmes involving guests, schools, communities and corporate partners
📚 Turtle Information Centre to promote awareness and education on sea turtle conservation
🌱 Community and CSR initiatives such as beach clean-ups, tree planting and environmental stewardship activities
🤝 Strategic partnerships with government agencies, NGOs and stakeholders to ensure responsible conservation practices

This achievement reflects the collective efforts of our team members, partners and local communities who share the same vision of protecting our natural heritage while creating meaningful experiences for our guests.

The award was proudly received on behalf of Resorts World Kijal by Mr Khew Choon Teck, Head of Leisure & Hospitality, and Puan Asmawatty Mohamad Kamal, whose leadership and dedication continue to drive our sustainability initiatives forward.

We are honoured to receive this recognition and remain committed to advancing sustainable tourism for future generations.

title: A Beautiful First at Resorts World Awana.
author: Resorts World Genting
body:
A Beautiful First at Resorts World Awana.
Resorts World Awana recently celebrated a special milestone by welcoming its very first Malay wedding, marking an exciting chapter in our wedding journey.

From the beautiful floral arrangements and elegant décor to the thoughtfully designed wedding stage, every detail came together to create a memorable setting for the happy couple and their loved ones.

The celebration was made even more meaningful with touches of Malay tradition, bringing warmth, culture and joy to the occasion.

It was wonderful to see our event space transformed for such a special day, showing how the right setting can bring a couple's wedding vision to life.

Here's to more beautiful celebrations and memorable moments at Resorts World Awana.

Planning your next special occasion or event? Get in touch with our team at meetings-events@rwgenting.com.
